Class SpringBeanJobFactory

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.AdaptableJobFactory
org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.SpringBeanJobFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
JobFactory, Aware, ApplicationContextAware, SchedulerContextAware
public class SpringBeanJobFactory extends AdaptableJobFactory implements ApplicationContextAware, SchedulerContextAware
Subclass of AdaptableJobFactory that also supports Spring-style dependency injection on bean properties. This is essentially the direct equivalent of Spring's QuartzJobBean in the shape of a Quartz JobFactory.

应用调度器上下文、作业数据映射和触发器数据映射条目作为 Bean 属性值。如果找不到匹配的 Bean 属性，则默认简单地忽略该条目。这与 QuartzJobBean 的行为类似。

与 Quartz 2.1.4 及更高版本兼容。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

  • Method Details

    • setIgnoredUnknownProperties

      public void setIgnoredUnknownProperties(String... ignoredUnknownProperties)
      Specify the unknown properties (not found in the bean) that should be ignored.

      默认为 `null`，表示应忽略所有未知属性。指定一个空数组以在出现任何未知属性时抛出异常，或者指定一个属性名称列表，如果在特定作业类中找不到对应的属性则忽略这些属性（其他所有未知属性仍将触发异常）。

    • setApplicationContext

      public void setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext applicationContext)
      描述从接口复制：ApplicationContextAware
      Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in. Normally this call will be used to initialize the object.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

      Specified by:
      `setApplicationContext` 接口 `ApplicationContextAware` 中
      Parameters:
      applicationContext - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象
      See Also:
      • BeanInitializationException

    • isEligibleForPropertyPopulation

      protected boolean isEligibleForPropertyPopulation(Object jobObject)
      Return whether the given job object is eligible for having its bean properties populated.

      默认实现会忽略 `QuartzJobBean` 实例，因为这些实例会自行注入 Bean 属性。

      Parameters:
